title: Common Service Centre (CSC) Digital Services
subtitle: Trusted hub for Aadhaar, PAN Card, Government Pensions, AEPS cash withdrawal and certificate registrations
placeholder_details: Specify your needs (e.g. want to apply for new PAN Card, link Aadhaar with phone, get Income certificate status)...
success_desc: We will get in touch with you shortly via WhatsApp or Phone.
srv_aadhaar_desc: Aadhaar card printing, address update help, linking verification, and e-KYC updates.
srv_pan_desc: New PAN card applications, updates/corrections, Aadhaar-PAN linking assistance, and e-PAN downloads.
srv_banking_desc: Aadhaar Enabled Payment System (AePS) cash withdrawal, balance inquiries, and mini-statements.
srv_certificates_desc: Official registrations for Income, Caste, Domicile, Birth, and Death certificates.
srv_pension_desc: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi, Old Age/Disability pensions, Ration Card modifications, and applications.
srv_forms_desc: Accurate online form filling for central/state government recruitments and college admission portals.
